function: Joint design of pilot signals, channel-feature extraction with quantized feedback, and multi-user downlink precoding for FDD massive MIMO, maximizing sum-rate (p. 1, p. 4).
system: BS with M=128 dual-polarized UPA antennas serves K single-antenna users, FDD downlink block fading at 3.5 GHz; no RIS (p. 3, p. 11).
method: RVQ-VAE feedback with FCN encoder plus edge graph attention precoder, trained end to end, unsupervised on the sum-rate loss, with stage-wise progressive training (p. 5-9).
data_channel: Own Wireless Insite ray-tracing at 3.5 GHz, 128 environments, 128,000 samples (100,000 train, 18,000 validation, 10,000 test); extra 3GPP CDL-B dataset (p. 11, p. 14).
test_conditions: Trained once at 20 dB, B=30, random K in 3-8; tested over SNR, B 5-30, each K, and 5 unseen ray-traced environments (p. 12-13).
baselines: Non-learned: WMMSE/ZF with perfect CSIT, ZF with LMMSE estimate, ZF with Lloyd RVQ feedback; learned: FCN design [6], VQ-VAE+GNN [30], CNN beamformer [34] (p. 11).
metrics: Sum-rate versus SNR, feedback bits, and users; sum-rate at unseen environments; quantization complexity (codewords); parameter count (p. 12-14).
complexity: FLOPs orders O(KML), O(KH^2), O(2^{B/N}DKN), O(K^2MH) in Table I; parameter counts 1.50M-1.97M in Table III (p. 9-10, p. 14).
openness: Code at https://github.com/LINZHU-PolyU/ScalablePrecoding-MU-MIMO (p. 12, footnote 3); no data link stated.
q1_support: p. 14: "the challenging CDL-B scenario, where channel distributions are characterized by predetermined path angles and delays as specified in the 3GPP standard"
q2_support: p. 13: "for testing, we include 5 additional unseen environments, which are also modeled using ray-tracing"
q3_support: p. 11: "WMMSE/ZF: CSIT" and "DL Method in [6]"; p. 12: "the proposed model significantly outperforms the DL-based methods"
q4_support: p. 9: "analyzes the computational complexity of the proposed scheme in terms of floating-point operations (FLOPs)"
q5_support: p. 12: "Our code can be found in https://github.com/LINZHU-PolyU/ScalablePrecoding-MU-MIMO"
notes: Joint pilot, feedback and precoding; main metric is sum-rate, so area 3 rather than 2. q1: the main dataset is own Wireless Insite ray tracing (p. 11), not DeepMIMO; q1 rests on the CDL-B experiment (p. 14), where 3GPP is cited without a TR number and training on the CDL dataset is implied, not stated. SNR sweeps not counted for q2.
